purpose: Static capability ranking policy for the production automation certification program. This file is TRACKED POLICY ONLY. It must never record dynamic production state - no stamps, no active capability, no current identity, no revision, and no verdicts. Durable current state lives in the private certification ledger and the sanitized Brain checkpoint, so that recording a stamp can never change the source SHA that stamp certifies.
dependencyRule: Every dependency must appear earlier in capabilityOrder than its dependent, so the ranking is a total order over a directed acyclic graph and can never cycle.
selectionRule: Exactly one capability is active. At most one independently proved instrumentation or authority blocker may accompany it. A recorded safety failure preempts core completion. A capability activates only when every declared dependency already holds a valid stamp. The general backlog is durable memory and never influences selection.

spreadsheet-admission.detail: The coordinated frontend adapter must be committed from the clean baseline and its source anchor recorded through a reviewed successor before spreadsheet admission can run.

invalidationRule: Any change to an identity field invalidates every stamp, because the stamp certified a bound identity that no longer exists. A changed production path invalidates only the stamps that declared it. An unknown or absent identity field fails closed and never silently preserves a stamp.
requiredEffectRule: A required effect must name an observed store, capture, or adapter projection. A scenario may never emit its own pass token.
